New vs Returning Card Spenders by Month

MediumFreeQuerying BasicsSubqueries & CTEsConditional LogicAggregation & GroupingJoins

Card spend grew every month of 2026. The question behind the chart: is it new spenders, or the people who were already spending? A user is new in the month of their first completed card payment ever — across the whole ledger, which starts in June 2025 — and returning in every later month.

Use completed card payments only (type = 'card_payment', status = 'completed'). For each month from 2026-01 to 2026-08, show exactly these 5 columns: month (YYYY-MM), new_spenders, new_spend_gbp, returning_spenders and returning_spend_gbp (spend in amount_gbp, rounded to 2 decimals). Order by month.

Someone whose first card payment was in December 2025 is returning in January 2026, not new.

Hint

Find each user's first spending month over the full ledger in its own step, and only then keep 2026. If you keep 2026 first, everyone who already spent in 2025 looks new in January.
